name: Ibirasuchus
isnote: English Wikipedia places it in Itasuchidae (Notosuchia); the atlas has no Itasuchidae clade, so it sits in Notosuchia.
sum: Ibirasuchus is a medium to large itasuchid notosuchian from the Santonian São José do Rio Preto Formation (Bauru Group) of Brazil.
wsnote: Up to 4 m, estimated from proxies (English Wikipedia); the page calls it medium to large.
holotype: Several skull-table bones (a small part of the squamosal, parietal and supraoccipital) found in 2008; catalogue number not given on the page.
biology: Itasuchids are generally interpreted as semi-aquatic (English Wikipedia).
author: Iori et al. 2025

sources.text: Iori, F. V., Marinho, T. S., Paschoa, L. S., Fernandes, R. O., Tavares, S. S. and Montefeltro, F. C. 2025. Crocodyliforms of the São José do Rio Preto Formation (Bauru Basin, Upper Cretaceous), taxonomic and preservational aspects. Journal of South American Earth Sciences 105718.

dates_note: No PBDB occurrences. Santonian per English Wikipedia; whole ICS stage used.
